#Module webcodecs_encoders

WebCodecs VideoEncoder / AudioEncoder (src/page/bindings_encoders.odin, native/js/runtime/web_webcodecs_encoders.c). No encoder is linked in this build, so isConfigSupported is honestly false and configure raises NotSupportedError. The objects and their state machine exist so feature detection and new VideoEncoder({...}) behave; when an encoder crate is added, configure()/encode() wire to it here.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/webcodecs_encoders.widl.

#Types

#handle VideoEncoder : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_VideoEncoder).
